???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "Why does marking dead code from live roots delete more than counting uses does?"

        Values that only feed each other, such as a counter nobody reads, always have a use and so are never deleted by counting; marking from roots reaches only what a live output, statement or branch needs.

        Introduced in [O5. Constants and dead code](o5-constants-and-dead-code.md).

    ??? question "What must a stack slot satisfy for mem2reg to promote it to SSA values?"

        It must be an alloca in the entry block, hold a single value such as a scalar or a pointer, and be used only by direct loads and stores. A struct or an array is not a single value.

        Introduced in [O3. SSA form: construction and destruction](o3-ssa.md).

    ??? question "What do we call a value made of other values, and which v0.1 types are like that?"

        An aggregate. In v0.1 the aggregates are arrays and structs.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 8. Data in memory](../compiler/guide/stage-8-data-in-memory.md). Specification: [12. Glossary](../specification/glossary.md).

    ??? question "What is `square(4.0)` an example of, and what happens when it runs?"

        A function call. The function's body runs, then execution carries on from just after the call.

        Introduced in [Learn: 5. Expressions](../language-tour/08-expressions.md). Specification: [5. Expressions](../specification/expressions.md#calls).
